annotations.title: Fuel prices in EU countries (European Commission)

description: Use for fuel prices in other EU countries, Poland against the EU, and where to fill the tank on a trip abroad. Say that the prices are national averages. Prices of Euro-super 95 petrol, diesel, LPG or heating oil at filling stations in the 27 EU countries from the European Commission Weekly Oil Bulletin (Monday prices, weekly since 2005): PLN and EUR per litre with all taxes, without taxes and tax share, rank from the cheapest, weekly change, a year earlier, the EU and euro area weighted averages, the difference for a full tank against Poland and the finwire index finwire_eu_fuel_price_gap. PLN prices use the NBP EUR mid rate of the reading day. These are national averages; motorway stations are usually more expensive.

country.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) to compare with Poland, default DE.

tank.description: Tank size in litres for the full-tank difference, default 50.
